title: Snapped the receipt?
Keep the paper too.
lead: CRA says you generally must keep paper originals. A photo can help, but it has to be a good one.

items: An accurate copy of the whole receipt
Shows the same info as the paper
Details not blurry, faded or too dark
Emailed receipt? Keep the digital file

blocks.text: Paper can go only if imaged to the CGSB standard. Unsure? CRA says get legal advice first.
